purpose: Define the only permitted bridge from the v0.11 synthetic 250x100 k=15 pass to an empirical flower-colour analysis: use measurement evaluability only to freeze the actual retained geometry, then requalify that geometry synthetically before any colour-derived TTF statistic is inspected.

permitted_before_actual_geometry_freeze: measurement_evaluable boolean/status produced by the independently frozen colour-measurement pipeline
forbidden_before_actual_geometry_requali: Jensen-Shannon or other pairwise colour distances
measurement_firewall.pixel_processing_role: Pixels may be processed only by the independently frozen measurement pipeline to determine evaluability and later colour representation. TTF must not inspect pixels or colour values during this gate.

classifiability_gate.retained_record_selection: Among evaluable records within each frozen species, select the 40 smallest SHA256 keys of '20260924\x1f' + photo_id. This selection uses no colour value.

actual_geometry_architecture.species_split: reuse exactly the v0.11 125/125 species split; do not redraw
actual_geometry_architecture.execution_operator: same exact Gaussian opportunity-corrected segment-integrated transfer operator as v0.11; chunking may change storage only
actual_geometry_architecture.training_response: same frozen training-side edge-length orthogonalized turnover

synthetic_requalification.pass_rule: maximum Wilson 95% upper bound across the four private cells <= 0.10 AND Wilson 95% lower bound for shared A2 >= 0.80
synthetic_requalification.if_fail: Freeze failure and stop empirical TTF. Do not tune k, bandwidth, record count, species membership, profiling, thresholds, or synthetic cells on this geometry.
synthetic_requalification.if_pass: Only then may a separately authorized empirical TTF run read the frozen colour representation for these exact 10,000 retained records.

claim_boundary: A v0.12 pass establishes only synthetic adequacy on the classifiability-filtered actual geometry. It does not itself establish an empirical shared flower-colour boundary, biological prevalence, environmental cause, historical cause, or pollinator mechanism.
